name: concurrent-conflicting-approvals
invariant: Of concurrent conflicting approvals of one proposal exactly one applies, the others stale in the writer; independently, authority refuses to confirm a proposal no longer open, directly and through commands decided against its new version (03 "The writer"; 04 "Proposals and confirmation"). M0 has no proposal.confirm command wired to the writer: the fixture's command calls authority's confirm and close in the transaction.
